## Instrument SOP boundary

Complete these items when this pull request changes text inside an instrument's **Standard Operating Protocol** section. Otherwise, write **Not applicable**.

- [ ] The SOP remains a short state-transition sequence containing only unavoidable normal-use and safety-critical actions.
- [ ] Procedure content remains bullet-only, with no embedded media, tables, tutorials, or screenshot sequences; optional visuals are inline links.
- [ ] When characterization branches, the SOP uses a general characterization step linked to detailed operating instructions instead of enumerating capabilities.
- [ ] Level 1 teaching operations, capability previews, optional accessories, interpretation, and abnormal recovery remain outside the SOP.
- [ ] An instrument-knowledgeable reviewer has checked that no necessary mechanical, interface, safety, saving, unloading, cleanup, or final-state step was lost.
